description: Turn ONE photo of a furniture piece (sofa, chair, table, lamp…) into a textured, downloadable GLB 3D model. Costs 75 MeltFlex credits (refunded if the build fails). Takes about 2–3 minutes; this tool waits for the model. Best input: one piece, front three-quarter view, plain or white background, nothing cropped. The .glb is downloaded to disk and the file path is returned, along with signed USDZ/FBX/OBJ links (valid ~72 h).

image.description: Photo of ONE furniture piece: a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/...;base64,... URL.

output_path.description: Where to save the .glb. Defaults to ./meltflex-output/furniture-<timestamp>.glb in the current working directory.

textured.description: Default true (baked PBR textures). false → bare geometry only: faster, smaller, same price.

name: furniture_to_3d
title: Convert a furniture photo to a 3D model
